channel.title: Public Preview on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Public Preview on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Front Door profile and route level WAF policies
item.description:
Azure Front Door Web Application Firewall (WAF) now supports associating WAF policies at the profile and route levels in public preview. This lets you apply baseline protection across a profile and more targeted policies on specific routes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Reader Endpoint for Azure Database for MySQL
item.description:
Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server now has a public preview of a reader endpoint to simplify connection management when using multiple replicas. The endpoint provides automatic load balancing for read-only connections.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Per-disk resiliency for Azure VMs
item.description:
Azure VMs now have a public preview option for per-disk resiliency. By default, Azure still recovers a VM by shutting it down and powering it back on after managed disk connectivity is restored.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: aks: AppNet 2026-08-19
item.description:
AppNet 2026-08-19 adds public preview availability in more Azure regions, retires AppNet 1.0–1.2, and updates supported versions to Istio 1.28.10, 1.29.6, and new AppNet 1.5 on Istio 1.30.3. The release also includes fixes for cluster validation, gateway CRD conflicts, certificate rotation, multicluster traffic, identity-based updates, cleanup on delete/leave, diagnostics, and clearer error reporting.

  • Source: Release notes from AKS

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: IPv6 dual-stack support for Azure Bastion
item.description:
Azure Bastion now supports IPv4 and IPv6 dual-stack configurations in public preview. New Bastion deployments can be configured with both IPv4 and IPv6 public IP addresses.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Introducing Live Reports for Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Live Reports are now in Public Preview for Azure SRE Agent. They let operations teams create dynamic operational views from SRE Agent conversations and keep them updated with the latest data.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Push rules in rulesets now support path exceptions
item.description:
Push rules in GitHub rulesets now support path exceptions, letting you exempt specific file paths so a rule applies everywhere else in scope. The feature is available in public preview.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: The new GitHub Copilot experience in Slack
item.description:
GitHub’s Slack integration now includes agentic GitHub Copilot capabilities from Copilot CLI and the Copilot app, available in public preview. Users can interact with @GitHub in Slack to work with these features.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL Formatter in MSSQL extension
item.description:
The MSSQL extension now includes SQL Formatter in public preview, letting you format SQL scripts directly in the editor. It adds customizable formatting options to align scripts with a preferred coding style.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Ipv6 support in Azure Firewall
item.description:
Azure Firewall is now in public preview with IPv6 support. Customers can configure Azure Firewall and Firewall Policy in dual-stack mode for IPv4 and IPv6 traffic, including native IPv6 network-rule filtering and DNS Proxy support.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Zone redundancy for Azure SQL Managed Instance Next-gen General Purpose
item.description:
Azure SQL Managed Instance Next-gen General Purpose now supports public preview of zone redundancy. It automatically distributes compute and data across availability zones to improve resilience and business continuity.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Linux on WSL
item.description:
Azure Linux on WSL is available in Public Preview (Beta). It lets teams run Azure Linux on developer workstations to validate production-aligned behavior, reproduce issues more reliably, and reduce debugging time.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Rule insights for organizations in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has released the rule insights dashboard in public preview for organizations. It provides a visual overview of how repository rulesets are evaluated and enforced at the organization level.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Front Door mutual TLS
item.description:
Azure Front Door now supports mutual TLS in public preview. It lets Front Door authenticate clients with X.509 certificates before forwarding requests to the application.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Markdown for Agents in Azure App Service
item.description:
Azure App Service now has a public preview of Markdown for Agents. When a client requests Markdown, App Service can automatically serve a cleaner Markdown version of app content for AI agents and other tools.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: “Relates to” issue relationship in public preview and multi-select fields is generally available
item.description:
GitHub added a new public preview issue relationship called “Relates to” for connecting related work, and multi-select fields are now generally available for GitHub Projects.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure ExpressRoute resiliency guard
item.description:
Azure ExpressRoute resiliency guard is in public preview for ExpressRoute virtual network gateways. A new resiliency model property lets you declare whether a gateway is for single-homed or multi-homed configurations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Perimeter link feature in network security perimeter
item.description:
Microsoft Azure added a public preview of Perimeter link (cross-perimeter connectivity) for network security perimeter. It lets trusted resources in different perimeters communicate securely using Managed Identity (MSI) without adding extra network access rules.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Private Link support over IPv6
item.description:
Azure Private Link now supports IPv6 in public preview. IPv6 private endpoints can be used from IPv6 clients in an Azure virtual network to privately access Azure PaaS services such as Azure Storage and Azure SQL Database.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure DNS enables DNS-based load balancing through Traffic Manager integration
item.description:
Azure DNS now supports direct integration with Azure Traffic Manager for DNS-based traffic routing in preview. This lets you associate an Azure DNS record set with a Traffic Manager profile without creating a CNAME to the trafficmanager.net domain.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Route-Maps for Azure Route Server
item.description:
Route maps for Azure Route Server are in public preview. They let customers control inbound and outbound routing on hybrid connections by managing routes advertised to and from Azure Route Server BGP peerings.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for late-July
item.description:
Azure SQL added a public preview of regex-based dynamic data masking. It extends built-in DDM with pattern-based masking for sensitive data such as emails, phone numbers, and identifiers.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Enterprise teams model policy targeting in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has added user-based model policy targeting for enterprise teams in public preview. It is available to GitHub Enterprise customers with Copilot Business or Copilot Enterprise licenses and lets AI administrators set a baseline policy.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Symmetric keys on Azure Key Vault Premium
item.description:
Azure Key Vault Premium now supports symmetric keys in public preview. The preview lets customers and partners evaluate symmetric encryption using oct-HSM keys and AES.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Support for SMB Opportunistic Locking (Oplocks) configuration
item.description:
Azure NetApp Files public preview adds configurable SMB opportunistic locking (oplocks) for SMB and dual-protocol volumes. Oplocks remain enabled by default and can be set on new volumes or updated on existing ones.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Stacked pull requests are now in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has put stacked pull requests into public preview. The feature lets users split a larger change into an ordered series of smaller, reviewable pull requests.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Monitor Logs mirroring into Microsoft Fabric
item.description:
Azure Monitor Logs can now be mirrored from Log Analytics workspaces into Microsoft Fabric in public preview. The telemetry is available in OneLake as Delta Parquet with near real-time availability and no data duplication.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Enclave
item.description:
Azure Enclave is now in public preview for Microsoft Azure, Azure Government, Azure Government Secret, and Azure Government Top Secret. It is intended to simplify deployment and management of isolated cloud environments for sensitive workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Prepared Image Specification
item.description:
Azure announces a public preview of Prepared Image Specification for AKS workloads that need faster node startup. The feature is aimed at reducing delays caused by repeated container image downloads and initialization on new nodes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI Gateway in Azure API Management
item.description:
Azure API Management now has an AI Gateway tier in public preview. It is a dedicated tier designed for AI workloads, extending AI gateway capabilities already available in other API Management tiers.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Multi-select fields for Projects and Issues in public preview
item.description:
GitHub Projects and Issue fields now support multi-select fields in public preview, allowing a single field to store multiple values. This lets you tag an item with all relevant labels or categories instead of choosing just one.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure DDoS Protection custom policy
item.description:
Azure DDoS Protection custom policy is in public preview. It lets customers set per-resource DDoS mitigation thresholds for protected Standard Load Balancer frontend IP configurations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Agent automation controls in GitHub Issues in public preview
item.description:
GitHub Issues now exposes the reason behind agent-driven changes and lets users review proposed automation actions before they are applied. The feature is in public preview.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Standard service endpoint
item.description:
Standard service endpoint is in public preview. It provides a more scalable and secure way to connect IaaS workloads to Azure PaaS services within the Private Link family, addressing scale and management limits of earlier approaches.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Protect sensitive generative AI telemetry in Application Insights and Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Application Insights now stores generative AI content in a dedicated GenAIContent table (AppGenAIContent in Log Analytics), enabling access controls for sensitive AI telemetry. The update is in public preview.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Public Preview: Azure Functions Support for PowerShell 7.6
item.description:
Azure Functions now supports PowerShell 7.6 in public preview. You can develop locally with PowerShell 7.6 and deploy to Azure Functions plans.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Xcode 27 runner image now in public preview
item.description:
GitHub-hosted macOS runners now support Xcode 27 in public preview, letting you build and test Apple apps against the latest Xcode version. This is an early-access runner image release.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: Announcing: Tracing for Microsoft Agent Framework (Python and .NET)
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry now provides public preview tracing support for Microsoft Agent Framework in Python and .NET. The feature lets developers observe agent reasoning, tool calls, and model interactions during execution.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: CodeAct pattern and Hyperlight containers in Microsoft Agent Framework
item.description:
Microsoft Agent Framework now includes the CodeAct pattern in public preview. It lets agents execute multi-step plans as a single code block instead of sequential tool calls, which reduced end-to-end latency in representative workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Episodic procedural memory in Microsoft Agent Framework
item.description:
Microsoft Agent Framework now has episodic procedural memory in public preview. It stores successful task patterns so agents can reuse past action sequences, tool choices, and related context on similar future requests.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Agent Channel for Microsoft Agent Framework multi-agent communication
item.description:
Microsoft Agent Framework now includes Agent Channel in public preview for multi-agent communication. It provides a built-in way for agents to exchange typed messages using request/response or fire-and-forget patterns without custom routing code.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for mid-July 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL added Shortcut Configuration in Visual Studio Code preview, allowing users to customize keyboard shortcuts for Quick Queries, the Results Grid, and the Query Editor. The update is listed as a public preview for mid-July 2026.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Advanced platform metrics in Azure Monitor
item.description:
Azure Monitor now has advanced platform metrics in Public Preview starting July 15, 2026. The preview adds improved visibility into platform performance, resource health, and operational trends for supported Azure services.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: DevUI Agent Inspector for Microsoft Agent Framework
item.description:
Microsoft Agent Framework now includes DevUI Agent Inspector in public preview. It provides a local debugging view for agent runs with a tree of model calls, tool invocations, and intermediate state, plus controls to pause, replay, and edit prompts during execution.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Front Door edge actions
item.description:
Azure Front Door edge actions are now in public preview. They let customers run lightweight JavaScript during request processing at the edge for real-time decisions closer to users.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Security reviews now available in the GitHub Copilot app
item.description:
GitHub Copilot app now supports running security reviews on in-flight code changes with the /security-review slash command. The feature is available in public preview.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Code Quality license estimate in public preview
item.description:
GitHub Code Quality now shows the number of active committers for repositories across an enterprise, providing an estimate of Code Quality license cost before it is finalized. The feature is in public preview.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Manage Azure Chaos Studio from the Azure CLI
item.description:
Azure Chaos Studio now has a public preview Azure CLI extension (az chaos) for creating and running resilience scenarios. It reduces the need to manually craft REST calls and JSON files, and includes a one-step setup command to provision the required workspace and related resources.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Codex as agent provider and agentic enhancements in JetBrains IDEs
item.description:
GitHub added Codex as a new agent provider in public preview. JetBrains IDE updates also include Hooks support in the Customizations editor, richer MCP server management, and custom model support via configuration.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Exceptions in WAF for Azure Application Gateway and Azure Front Door
item.description:
Azure Web Application Firewall now has an exceptions feature in public preview for Azure Application Gateway and Azure Front Door. It lets you allow specific requests that would otherwise be blocked as false positives, complementing existing exclusions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Chaos Studio Workspaces and Scenarios
item.description:
Azure Chaos Studio introduces public preview support for Workspaces and Scenarios. Workspaces let you target an application’s scope, such as a subscription, resource group, or service group, to run chaos testing in a more application-centric way.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Export historical data from Log Analytics workspace with Export jobs
item.description:
Azure Log Analytics now has a public preview Export job feature for exporting historical workspace data to an Azure Storage account. Exports are driven by a query and time range so you can retrieve only the needed data for external use.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Copilot agent session streaming is now in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has put Copilot agent session streaming into public preview for Enterprise Cloud customers with enterprise managed users. Session data is available across Copilot clients, including cloud agents on github.com and data-resident deployments.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Public Preview: Document PII playground sample in Microsoft Foundry NextGen
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry NextGen now includes a public preview playground for document-based PII detection in Azure AI Language. The sample loads a prepared document, runs document PII detection, and displays the redacted output.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Instant Access via application consistent restore points
item.description:
Azure added Instant Access for VM Restore Points in public preview. It lets you restore disks immediately after a restore point is created, without waiting for background replication.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Public Preview: Azure Storage Mover now supports migration from Google Cloud Storage (GCS)
item.description:
Azure Storage Mover Public Preview now supports cloud-to-cloud migration from Google Cloud Storage (GCS) to Azure Blob Storage. Migration uses the S3-compatible interface.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Open source license compliance is in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has put open source license compliance into public preview for enterprises. The feature adds centralized, ruleset-based checks to enforce dependency license policy and block noncompliant licenses.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Enterprise-managed settings now support strictKnownMarketplaces in VS Code and GitHub Copilot CLI
item.description:
GitHub added enterprise-managed support for strictKnownMarketplaces in VS Code and GitHub Copilot CLI. The setting is in public preview and lets enterprises control which plugins users can install.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Saved views for repository issues – Public Preview and adjustable row heights in projects
item.description:
GitHub added saved views to repository Issues pages in public preview, allowing teams to create and share filtered issue views. The release also includes adjustable row heights in Projects.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Red Hat Enterprise Linux runner images are now in public preview
item.description:
GitHub-hosted larger runners now support Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 and 10 images in public preview. The images were introduced in partnership with Red Hat and are available for organizations to use.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Application Gateway for Containers – Inference gateway
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers is adding a preview inference gateway capability. It brings the Kubernetes Gateway API Inference Extension to support AI inference traffic handling for Kubernetes workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Fetch Code Quality findings via REST API
item.description:
GitHub has added repository-level REST APIs for Code Quality findings in public preview. The new read-only endpoints expose code quality data via API, bringing parity closer to the GitHub UI.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Detecting Duplicate Issues – Public Preview and issue fields MCP support for GitHub Issues
item.description:
GitHub Issues adds duplicate issue detection in public preview and expands MCP support for issue fields. The change is aimed at reducing duplicate triage work for maintainers, especially in large repositories.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Control who and what triggers GitHub Actions workflows
item.description:
GitHub Actions now has workflow execution protections in public preview for GitHub Enterprise, organizations, and repositories. Administrators can define allow lists to control which users or events can trigger workflows.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Databricks natively storing data in Microsoft OneLake
item.description:
Azure Databricks now supports natively writing managed Delta tables to Microsoft OneLake in public preview. This lets customers use OneLake as the storage layer for Databricks workloads without managing separate storage accounts.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Migrate – GitHub Copilot Modernization integration for at scale code assessments
item.description:
Azure Migrate public preview now integrates with GitHub Copilot Modernization to provide at-scale code insights. The integration combines Azure Migrate’s portfolio-level discovery and assessment with Copilot’s context-aware code analysis.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: New project templates and template gallery for Azure Functions in VS Code
item.description:
The Azure Functions VS Code extension adds a redesigned Create New Project experience in public preview. It replaces the multi-step Quick Pick wizard with a searchable, filterable visual template gallery.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: New runner images in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has added two new GitHub-hosted runner images for Actions in public preview. They are available to all users so workflows can be tested on the latest platforms before general release.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Agentic Workflows is now in public preview
item.description:
GitHub Agentic Workflows is now in public preview. It lets you automate reasoning-based tasks such as issue triage, CI failure analysis, and documentation updates using coding agents inside GitHub.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Dedicated security review command now available in Copilot CLI
item.description:
GitHub Copilot CLI now includes an experimental /security-review slash command for running security reviews on code changes directly in the CLI. The feature is in public preview.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agent mode for GitHub Copilot in SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS)
item.description:
GitHub Copilot Agent mode is now in public preview in SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS). It can help investigate performance issues, tune queries, review maintenance and configuration, identify security concerns, troubleshoot errors, and assist with operational tasks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Site Recovery support for Linux Azure VMs with NVMe disk controllers.
item.description:
Azure Site Recovery now supports replication and disaster recovery for Linux Azure VMs with NVMe disk controllers in Azure-to-Azure scenarios. The feature is in public preview and applies to NVMe-enabled Generation 2 VM families such as Da/Ea/Fa v6 and Ebsv5/Ebdsv5.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Managed Redis now supports Entra ID based RBAC for data management
item.description:
Azure Managed Redis public preview adds Microsoft Entra ID-based RBAC for data access. This lets you control read, write, and admin permissions without using shared keys, using Redis ACLs underneath.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Ingestion Volume Change dashboard in Metrics Usage Insights
item.description:
Metrics Usage Insights now has an Ingestion Volume Change dashboard in public preview. It lets you compare ingestion volume over time to spot spikes or drops in time series counts and event ingestion rates.

  • Source: Azure Updates
